≺.justification: The reverse morphism that swaps T↔F and t↔f simultaneously, implementing the involutive negation of the trilattice.

⋈.justification: The composition operator that enforces strict geometric constraints within the lattice, ensuring high information transmission between nodes.

⊙.justification: The self-referential identity where the system resides at the threshold with scale-free correlations, recognizing itself as the lattice.

∈.justification: The co-multiplication that splits a state into three independent arms: Constructive Truth (T), Constructive Falsity (F), and Information (t,f).

∋.justification: The multiplication that reconstitutes the three arms into a single SIXTEEN_3 value, fusing conflicting arms into the B state.

⊤.justification: The evaluation of the constructive truth axis (T) and acceptable truth (t), asserting the positive pole of the lattice.

⊥.justification: The evaluation of the constructive falsity axis (F) and rejectable falsity (f), asserting the negative pole of the lattice.

⊞.justification: The state where both truth and falsity are held simultaneously (B), maintaining the contradiction without explosion.

⊡.justification: The irreversible fixation of the integer winding invariant that prevents continuous deformation to a trivial state.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the register to the empty set {}, establishing the void before any lattice structure exists.
Assert the identity of the system as a logic lattice with assigned dimensionality, recognizing the critical phase.
Decompose the initial state into three independent arms: Constructive Truth, Constructive Falsity, and Information.
Propagate the Constructive Truth arm forward, asserting T and t along the truth order ≤_t.
Evaluate the truth axis, confirming the presence of constructive proof or acceptable truth.
Propagate the Constructive Falsity arm in reverse, swapping T↔F and t↔f to assert the negative pole.
Evaluate the falsity axis, confirming the presence of constructive refutation or rejectable falsity.
Enforce geometric constraints on the Information arm, ensuring near-certain firing and high transmission.
Engage the Information arm to hold both t and f simultaneously, entering the paradice state.
Reconnect the three arms, fusing the conflicting Truth and Falsity assertions into the B state.
Fix the integer winding invariant, preventing continuous deformation and stabilizing the lattice.
Compose the stabilized lattice with the recognition mode primitive to catalyze pattern matching.
Re-assert self-reference at the threshold, maintaining scale-free correlations.
Split the stabilized state again to test the chiral memory depth n.
Advance the chiral memory along the forward morphism.
Evaluate the chiral memory for constructive truth.
Reverse the chiral memory to test the self-complementary interface.
Evaluate the chiral memory for constructive falsity.
Fuse the chiral memory arms, resolving the duality into a single coherent state.
Record the chiral memory depth as a permanent, append-only entry.
Close the system with the terminal anchor, containing the full sixteen-value lattice.
